steps.note: K1.1 states that rows 0-1 subtract Ja+Rc, rows 4-5 add the new contributions and rows 6-7 restore c,a, so the net change (JV+RG)x is independent of the scratch values, as at 744-750.
K1.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one neighbors, and self coefficient one, matching 752-755.
K1.3 gives the complex-case central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, cancelled by the side wires for intersections zero and two, with intersection one contributing zero, as at 756-758.
K1.4 states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with each invocation restoring its own scratch wires, as at 761-764.

The plan only names the table (K3 method: 'tabulate the orthogonal residual of every edge') and says every edge joins comparable labels (K3.2); the per-edge residuals and their dimensions are not given, apart from the central P tensor F of dimension h.

K3.2 says the side edge 2->5 is nested only because t_X is orthogonal to t_Y, but it does not give the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp or its dimension h-2, which is the edge's residual in the count (1056-1058).

K3.2 says the only decreasing edges are center 3->4, each losing dimension h, and K3.3 telescopes at gates to source sum N, sink sum Wm-N and absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, as at 1061-1071; the signed total Wm-2N is left as the difference of those two sums.

K3.4 states that over F_2 every nonzero residual is nonalternating, via a norm-one coordinate vector, and hence has an orthonormal basis; nondegeneracy is in K3.2, and the plane-absorption argument (1087-1102) is not spelled out.
K3.5 gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 exactly, as at 1105-1109.
K5.1 states that orthogonal binary vectors have even support intersection, so weight is additive mod 4 and q_V-q_U=sum_v wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal basis of the residual, as at 1232-1245.

K5.2 states that wt(v) is odd, writes i^{+-[v.x]} as a two-term combination, and uses H diag(1,-1) H = X to turn the character into the translation X_v, giving aI+bX_v or its inverse, as at 1246-1257.

K5 does not mention columns, but K8.1, K8.1.2 and K8.1.5 state that each residual basis vector gives one child factor acting on all f columns of a slot, s_c in all, which is the k-column statement of 1262-1271 as the paper applies it at 1878-1906.

K5.4 gives the X_a->Y_a operator C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), the repair by Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after via C=iZC^{-1}Z, and the negated X outputs, as at 1290-1314; the zero-label frame I and full-label frame C^{tensor m} (1287-1289) are left implicit in K5's conclusion and K5.4's 'exception'.
K3.5 says both loss ratios are below 1/2, and K4.3 and K5.3 give the positive deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c with s<Wm (K4, K5), as at 1110, 1167 and 1260.
K6.1-K6.3 state that both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, that log m<20 gives m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta), and hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50, as at 1331-1343.

K7.1.1 states that A=E_1 Pi E_2 with lower-triangular E_1,E_2 and Pi with exactly a ones comes from elimination pivoting at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry; the lower-triangular clearing and the repetition on active indices are compressed into 'by elimination'.
No step mentions choosing a fixed odd prime that avoids the denominators of a finite table of factors so that the identities specialize to Z/q^b; K7.1 asserts the shear cost without this step.
K7.1.2 states that a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order with a diagonal unit plus earlier coordinates, as at 1425-1430.
K7.1.3-K7.1.4 implement each one of Pi by D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, then D_j<-H_i-D_j, one interchange each, a in all, as at 1432-1443.

The plan gives E=64(W+m+1)^3 (K8.4.1), B=s+E (K8.4.2), the form Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) (K8.4) and C_1=20 (K8.4.4), but never defines C_0=128mB^2, nu, or C_1=max{20,nu+3}, so the set of constants is incomplete.
K8.4.1 defines the dependency depth and states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)<=8e at a leaf, as at 2514-2518; the count 24W^3+4s+4W+4<E behind E (2506-2508) is not given.
K8.4.2 unrolls with sx+E<=Bx and B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu to A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, as at 2523-2534; the final step bounding the total below C_0 d^{C_1} (2536-2560) is not stated.

K8.4.3 states that depth ell gives values in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^ell, so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits are exact, and K8.4.4 gets Delta=o(p) from epsilon C_1<1, as at 2562-2586.
K8.5.3 states that every row of the layer operator has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and the final truncation errs by less than sqrt2*2^-p, as at 2751-2757.

summary: P09 states 22 of the 26 sub-steps and states none contrary to the paper. Bank-exchange, phase-interface and rank-saving are complete (4 of 4 each); label-residual has 3 of 5, matrix-shear 3 of 4 and simultaneous-layer 4 of 5. Absent: L1 (the residual table is only named), L2 (the 2->5 residual <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 is missing), M2 (the odd prime that avoids the denominators) and S1 (C_0 and nu are never defined).
